title: Influence Functions: A Unified Differentiation-Based Framework
abstract: arXiv:2501.15307v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper introduces a direct differentiation-based framework that unifies the derivation of influence functions across parametric, nonparametric, and semiparametric models. We show that the Riesz representer of the functional derivative is obtained by orthogonally projecting the identification function onto the subspace of mean-zero functions, so the influence function is a linear transformation of the moment function. This approach extends seamlessly to infinite-dimensional parameters and reveals a common algebraic form across both finite- and infinite-dimensional cases. It demonstrates that the slower nonparametric convergence rate arises from approximating the infeasible Dirac delta function. The same framework further applies to semiparametric multi-step plug-in estimation, where it automatically yields locally robust moment functions. Crucially, by employing distributional derivatives, the method accommodates non-smooth moment

translated_title: 影响函数：一个统一的基于微分的框架
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一个直接基于微分的框架，统一了参数模型、非参数模型和半参数模型中影响函数的推导。我们证明了泛函导数的Riesz表示子可以通过将识别函数正交投影到均值为零的函数子空间上获得，因此影响函数是矩函数的线性变换。该方法可以无缝扩展到无限维参数，并揭示了有限维与无限维情形下共同的代数形式。它证明了非参数估计较慢的收敛速度源于对不可行的狄拉克δ函数的逼近。同一框架还进一步适用于半参数多步骤代入估计，其中它能自动生成局部稳健的矩函数。关键的是，通过采用分布导数，该方法能够处理非光滑矩（函数）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的基于微分的框架，将参数、非参数和半参数模型中影响函数的推导统一起来，证明影响函数是矩函数的线性变换，并能自动生成局部稳健的矩函数。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified differentiation-based framework that derives influence functions across parametric, nonparametric, and semiparametric models, showing the influence function is a linear transformation of the moment function and automatically yields locally robust moment functions.
